title: Affine criterion for finite locally free sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $M$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. If for every affine open $U\subseteq X$ the module $\Gamma(U,M)$ is finitely presented and flat over $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$, then $M$ is finite locally free [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].
